verdict.rationale: Activepieces documents two places your data can live: its EU cloud, or your own infrastructure via self-hosting (Docker or Docker Compose). That gives a real choice of where data is stored. There is no documented region selector for the cloud, and no data-residency guarantees or detail on what data stays where. Missing for 10: a multi-region choice in the managed cloud, documented residency commitments, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)

citations.quote: On our EU cloud, or entirely inside your own network.
run it on your own infrastructure, and keep the governance your company needs.
Free on every plan, cloud or self-hosted.
